name: Sunagawa (Japan)
description: A maroon field charged at the centre with the Sunagawa city emblem in white: a cross-shaped device with rounded ends and a central ring.
history: Municipal flag of Sunagawa, a city in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 21 June 1948.

features.role: Sunagawa city emblem — a cross-shaped device with rounded ends and a central ring
